text_block_list.text:
It happened on the day I accompanied Maruzensky
on a shopping trip to the commercial district—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I see, I see... These green onions are simply gorgeous.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ma'am, along with the cabbage from earlier,
could I also get some of these green onions?♪

text_block_list.name: Greengrocer Auntie
text_block_list.text:
My, you really know your stuff, young lady!
For someone like you, maybe I'll throw in a few extra tickets as a bonus!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Look at you saying that~
You're just handing them out to everyone, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Greengrocer Auntie
text_block_list.text: Hahaha, that's not true at all!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
So-rry, so-rry!
Thanks for waiting, Trainer-kun♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
So-rry, so-rry!
Thanks for waiting, Trainer-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yeah, abso-tively!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Let's extend our date just a little bit longer, though!
You see, that lady told me something
just a moment ago—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the fun, fun lottery!
Anyone and everyone, come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ta-daaa!
Wanna give it a try together?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Right! I got a lottery ticket from the greengrocer earlier!
It'd be a total waste not to use it, don'tcha think?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Besides, you were nice enough to hang out with me today, Trainer-kun,
so if I win a fancy prize, I figured I'd give it to you~!
choice_data_list: I wonder if I'll win a grand prize?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Besides, you were nice enough to hang out with me today, Trainer-chan,
so if I win a fancy prize, I figured I'd give it to you~!
choice_data_list: I wonder if I'll win a grand prize?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
My! To think you would say that...
I can't wait to see your reaction when it hits♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let Maruzen-chan show you
what true good fortune looks like!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Will I hit it~? Or will I miss~?

Humming a tune,
Maruzensky grabbed the lever and spun the raffle drum.
And the result is—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Kyaaah! Amaziiing!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, did you hear, did you hear!?
I won the grand prize!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan, did you hear, did you hear!?
I won the grand prize!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Right, right?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
And so! This wonderful, luxurious prize
goes right to Trainer-kun!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
And so! This wonderful, luxurious prize
goes right to Trainer-chan!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: It's totally fine!

—However, it was Maruzensky's lottery ticket in the first place.
It feels a bit awkward accepting such a prize just as "thanks for keeping her company shopping."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there's no need to be so modest.
You're always such an earnest one.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Understood.
Then how about "dating" instead?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Right, just like shopping today!
You're coming with me on my hot spring trip!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Right, just like shopping today!
You're coming with me on my hot spring trip!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I think I'll be a teeny-tiny bit busy this year, so~...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: How about sometime next spring! What do you think? I figure we'll both be in good shape by then.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
All right, it's a deal!
I'll invite you once everything's ready, okay?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna make this trip super fun,
so you better look forward to it! Got it?
"And so, I promised to accompany Maruzensky on a 'hot spring trip' next year."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Fufu~n♪ How's that for ya!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ahem!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, just kidding.
Did I get a little too carried away?
choice_data_list: Since it's 1st prize, wouldn't it be fine to ride it?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You're a real softie for forgiving me~♪
In that case, I'm gonna get even more hyped up, you know?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You're a real softie for forgiving me~♪
In that case, I'm gonna get even more hyped up, you know?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...*ahem*.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun. Why don't we have
hamburg steaks together for our next lunch?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan. How about we get
hamburgers together for lunch next time?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Fufu, you really know how to play along♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Fufu, you really know how to play along♪
And so, the Premium Carrot Hamburg Steak became the main dish for our special lunch with Maruzensky.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Waaah! I got so many!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
“Still, with this much, it must put
Trainer-kun in quite a bind.
Carrots spoil faster than you'd think, after all.”
choice_data_list: Shall we share some with everyone too?
Shall we share some with everyone too?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
“Still, with this much, it must put
Trainer-chan in quite a bind.
Carrots spoil faster than you'd think, after all.”
choice_data_list: Shall we share some with everyone too?
Shall we share some with everyone too?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, good idea♪
Roger that, loud and clear!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hiii! Gather round, hungry kids!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Yeeeees!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, everyone's so full of energy
after having their snacks, aren't they~?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, thanks♪
Here, Trainer-kun, have one too.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, thanks♪
Here, Trainer-chan, have one too.

And Maruzensky and I each took
a carrot stick in hand.
—Lightly salted, it was a flavor that soaked right into a tired body.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ouch-ouch-ouch!
choice_data_list: Let's just say we were pretty lucky.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's true.
Just getting it right is a win in itself.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Giving just one carrot feels
a bit off, too. Hmmm...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I know! I'll cook it up into kinpira together with the green onions I bought earlier!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: It's a recipe straight from my mom, so it's super-duper delicious! Look forward to it!

A few days later, I happily enjoyed the
kinpira carrots she had shared with me.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Bummer! Maruzen is super shocked~!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Trainer-kun, I'm so sorry.
Looks like today is totally choboriba for me...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Trainer-chan, I'm so sorry.
Looks like today is totally choboriba for me...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Ah-ah, I really wanted
to win a proper prize for you. Bummer.

Together with a despondent Maruzensky,
we left the shopping district behind.
